verdict.rationale: Nix's CLI (nix-shell, nix develop, nix build, nix run) is scriptable and non-interactive-capable, and remote builds/binary caches plus real-world reports of CI/dev-team usage (nix-comm-9, nix-comm-7) support headless automation use. However, there is no first-party documentation specifically addressing CI integration, headless flags, or automation-oriented guides, and the llms.txt/docs-md probes returned 404s. missing for 10: dedicated CI/headless-mode documentation, official CI examples or GitHub Actions integration docs, independent verification of non-interactive flag behavior.
